svg.title: A composite index reads as the words of a dictionary: the status, then the day
svg.desc: The 24 orders in the order of the index: by status, Pending, Paid, Shipped, Delivered, then by day, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, two orders per day. Is(Paid) takes the six paid orders, in one stretch. paid.Is(tuesday) takes 109 and 113; paid.From(tuesday) takes 109 to 121. Range(Pending, Paid) takes the pending orders, then the paid ones. The orders of Tuesday, of any status, sit in four places: the components are never skipped, and this index has no such search.
svg.text: A composite index reads as the words of a dictionary: the status, then the day
OrderStatusDayIndex and the 24 orders of the lesson; a search fixes the components in their order
